AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE CLERMONT GARBAGE COLLECTION ORDINANCE; TO CHANGE THE BILLING

- PROCEDURES OF THE CITY REGARDING THE MONTHLY SANITARY AND HEALTH CHARGES ASSESSED; TO PROVIDE THAT THE TOWN CLERK IS AUTHORIZED TO NOTIFY THE PROPER AUTHORITIES OF HALL COUNTY, GEORGIA, AS TO ANY FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PREMISE WHICH IS NOT USING THE GARBAGE COLLECTION AND DISPOSAL SYSTEM OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, IN ORDER THAT HALL COUNTY MAY PROPERLY IMPOSE ITS ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT FEES; TO PROVIDE THAT ALL OTHER PROVISIONS OF THE ORDINANCE, AS AMENDED, SHALL CONTINUE AND REMAIN IN EFFECT; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, the Town of Clermont, by and through its Town Council, has previously adopted the Clermont Garbage Collection Ordinance, as amended, due to the health and welfare needs of the Town of Clermont, Georgia; and | WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia after consideration of the billing procedures of the Town, and in order to simplify said billing procedures and hold down the cost of the Town in providing this service, has determined that a change in the billing procedure of the ordinance is in the best interest of the Town; and

WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia also finds that it is appropriate that the Town notify Hall County, Georgia when a family residential premise is not utilizing the garbage collection and disposal system of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, in order that Hall County may properly assess its environmental impact fee;

THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED by the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by the authority of the Town Charter, as amended, and Art. IX, § Il, { Ill of the Georgia Constitution of 1983, as amended,
3: The foregoing recitals shall be included within this ordinance as a finding of the purposes and intent of the legislative (governing) body of the Town of Clermont, Georgia.
5: entirety, and the following is substituted in lieu thereof:
6:
- (a) The monthly sanitary and health charge for each residential premise shall be billed and collected on a bi-annual (every six months) basis (being January 1 and June 1), with said charge paid in advance each half-year. The Town shall send to each residential premise a bill for the monthly sanitary and health charge for each half-year (being January 1 and June 1) on the first day of the month which precedes the beginning of each six month period, and being on December 1 and May 1, and payment of the bill will be due by December 15 and May 15. The charge, at the election of the person owing the charge, may be paid up to a year in advance (however, such payment will not prevent or estop the Town Council from changing the fee as necessary in the discretion of the Town Council).

- (b) The Town Clerk, as her work schedule allows, is authorized to notify the proper departments and agents of Hall County, Georgia as to each single-family residential premise which is not using the garbage collection and disposal system of the Town of Clermont, Georgia,

in order that Hall County may properly assess its environmental impact fee. Such notification shall be as the schedule of the Clerk allows, and as requested by Hall County, Georgia.
